st: You've Come A Long Way, Baby
d: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) learn they arrested the wrong man in their first big robbery and murder case seven years ago. Meanwhile, they must also go undercover to investigate a string of murders of middle-aged prostitutes.

Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate the theft of a seemingly worthless music videotape which may have a tie to illegal drugs. Cagney's niece Bridget (guest star Amanda Wyss) visits with hopes of becoming an actress.

t: In the Heat of the Night
d: When an embezzler, Jimmy Ray, returns to Sparta after many years away, it stirs up old resentments as he encounters the families that he stole from years ago, including Virgil Tibbs’ sweet-natured Aunt Etta, who turns to Chief Gillespie for help.

t: In the Heat of the Night
d: A rich landowner, Horace Sloan, is visited by Candace Sloan, a distant cousin who claims her grandfather was cheated out of a portion of the Sloan family estate. Horace’s readiness to give Candace her legacy, puts him at odds with his son, Lamar.
The one-armed man caught in a police dragnet brings Kimble and Gerard face-to-face.
Mickey Rooney guests as former comic, turned bookmaker, whose troubles involved Richard Kimble.
Kimble hitches a ride with a local clergyman then suddenly, the cleric is killed by a sniper's bullet.
The man who attacked a blind woman is found dead, supposedly shot by the woman's cheating husband.

st: Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas
d: It's Christmastime, but McCabe isn't feeling so jolly as an ambitious assistant DA helps Jake find a murderous Santa Claus.
Mike's former partner returns to San Francisco, but not because of any longing for the good old days. He is back in town to kill the hired gunman who murdered his son years before.
A single .25 caliber pistol affects many lives in a single weekend.
A retired cobbler takes the rap for a shooting to protect the real killer, the grandson of his best friend.

Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) reluctantly go undercover as game show contestants to investigate a crooked television show. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels, Martin Kove as Victor Isbecki, and Carl Lumbly as Mark Petrie.

Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) turn up evidence of police corruption after an undercover investigation goes awry, and Lacey deals with the arrival of her father in Harvey Jr.'s (Tony La Toree) life. Also starring Al Waxman.

t: In the Heat of the Night
d: An impending trial will force Gillespie’s daughter Lana Farren to face her attackers, Carl DeLissa and Jack Smet. Meanwhile, mobster attorney Alvin Epp and his corrupt clients are determined to acquire her property for a large land development.

t: In the Heat of the Night
d: In this follow-up to 'Even Nice People,' Gillespie’s daughter, Lana Farran, continues to defend her home from her mother’s greedy ex-boyfriend Carl DeLissa and the mob who are willing to go to great lengths to acquire and develop it, even murder.

t: In the Heat of the Night
d: Harriet DeLong’s son Eugene teams up with a prison pastor, Bishop William Prinn, to get his father, Vic Glendon, off death row, but when Prinn is traveling to Sparta, he finds his life is in danger when his car is run off the highway by a stranger.
Kimble returns home and visits his sister Donna right under the nose of Gerard.
